title: Who is Marceline?
description:
Finally, the promised story of the mysterious girl from the other block of Hare and Bunny.... How could it be that she ended up in a boys' school? How does she live? What comes?
What other mysteries does Block B have for us?
Now is the time to better explore this school...

title: LoveBot
description:
In 2049, highly advanced and affectionate robots are becoming humanity's primary companions in place of real relationships. Xada makes his living by modifying these bots to fit their owners specific wants and needs. However, his newest job leaves the LoveBot strangely sentient, and asking for his help... Sparks will fly as Xada relearns human connection and helps uncover the truths behind the LoveBots' existence.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: That Time I Got Isekai’d To Another World With My Truck!!
description:
Birito Hondakawasuzuyota was just an ordinary Japanese delivery truck driver, until one day his truck was hit by an even bigger truck. In that moment, Birito was transported to another world with his truck, and he now finds himself hopelessly stuck inside a strange medieval fantasy.

Worse yet, his small delivery truck has gained sentience. It speaks, it moves on its own, and it seems to think that it’s not a truck at all. The truck is convinced that she’s actually a girl, and worst of all, she seems to think that she and Birito are in a relationship. An intimate relationship.

She says he's been “inside her” many times.

titles.title: That Time I Got Isekai’d To Another World With My Truck!!

title: JEFF WOODS THE KILLER
description: From lovers to enemies to lovers again. Immerse yourself in this romantic gay thriller in which the line between passion and obsession becomes dangerously blurred.

title: Suitor Armor
description: Lady-in-waiting, Lucia believes getting through the royal wedding will be the toughest part of her new life. That is until she finds herself falling head over heels with Modeus, an up and coming knight to the king's guard. With her new found interest, she is quickly awaken to the mysteries of the kingdom when she learns Modeus is in fact an enchanted suit of armor without a soul. Could there more to him than just shining armor?(Source: Webtoon)

title: 3:33 AM STORIES
description: Strange and terrifying stories that happen in the city while you are sleeping, inspired by probably real urban legends. Who knows?

title: You've gotta be kitten me!
description: They say cats are like awkward roommates. For Rupert that’s indeed the case since his cat is not only a cat. It’s a Cat girl!

title: Now, I am Demon King's Wife
description: In the world I was from, I was despised for being too honest. But in this new world, my honesty is needed by my husband, the Demon King.

titles.title: Now, I am Demon King's Wife

title: Sinbad's Trail
description: After years of preparation, Kijyl Mannard is finally ready to face his destiny, claim his reward, and sail the seven seas. He’s got the ship, the men, and Sinbad’s long-lost treasure map in hand. However, the one thing Kijyl doesn’t have is a clue when it comes to love.

title: Do as You're Told
description: After Jin, the intelligent school delinquent comes to the rescue of some stray cats, he catches the attention and friendship of Lance, the seemingly up-tight stand-up student. Secrets from the past and pains from the present begin to unfold, along with possible budding relationships. Jin already has plans to run away with his little sister. But fate seems to have another plan for the two of them.

title: Crescendo
description:
Aiden met Bryan during a survival idol audition. Now they are preparing to debut as a duo unit named Crescendo. But something happened and everything won't ever be the same anymore... 

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Icarus Rising
description:
Ten years ago, the Teras demons conquered mankind. The Angels, once guardians of humanity, abandoned the surface to their palace in the sky. In a world of darkness and despair, Icarus find hope and rise.

(Source: Art Street)

title: Waffle
description: Extremely shy and with low self-esteem, Joon, 14-year-old, does everything she can to avoid awkward interactions with others - in vain. Following her recent move to Tokyo, Japan, she will befriend two classmates who will help her overcome her demons. (Source: Webtoons)

title: THE ALPHA KING'S CLAIM
description: As the Alpha King of all werewolves and lycans, Aero needed to be fair to all. He ruled with an iron fist, a steady head, and a balanced emotion. He was perfect in everything except for one. He had issues with the opposite sex. Since a child, he hated women. He never liked them & always avoided them. However, what if a woman suddenly materialized on his bed just as he was about to sleep? How could he avoid her then? - Webtoons

title: What’s Wrong with a Mundane Kinda Romance?
description:
In a world riddled with dramas, manga, and movies, depicting love and romance through thick clouds of rose colored smoke and mirrors, what happens after the heart dust settles and reality sets in? With expectations set so high, what’s wrong with a mundane kinda romance?

(Source: Webtoon)

titles.title: What’s Wrong with a Mundane Kinda Romance?

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Katara and the Pirate's Silver
native_title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Katara and the Pirate's Silver
description:
Katara and the Pirate's Silver is a standalone graphic novel set in the Avatar universe during the events of Book Two: Earth that follows Katara as she gets separated from the rest of Team Avatar.

(Source: Avatar Wiki)

titles.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Katara and the Pirate's Silver
Avatar: The Last Airbender - Katara y la plata del pirata

title: My Girlfriend Is an Orc Warlord!
description: What happens when a Knight and an Orc girl meet? They start dating, of course. Updates irregularly, check out Patreon for more episodes!

titles.title: My Girlfriend Is an Orc Warlord!

title: Fluidum
description:
Jesse was born like every citizen in the Fluidum universe, spending their first 20 years shifting seamlessly between a male and female body. Now with only one year left until they must choose one body for the rest of their life, Jesse is questioning the unquestionable... why decide at all?

(Source: Webtoon)

title: What are the Chances
description:
Tricia believes that love is overrated. But when Elise walked in on the family bookshop she's working at, things began to change. After the encounter, she began seeing memories from her previous life and dreams about Elise every night. Who was Tricia in Elise's life before? She feels like the universe keeps playing a game with her. Witness this unlikely journey of friendship, acceptance, love and of life and death.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: My Succubus Girlfriend NEW
description: Izumo is a scary-looking top student. Everyone is afraid of him, but in reality, he just wants friends and a fun school life. One day he is targeted by a succubus named Anastasia who attempts to steal his virginity.

title: AntiSTALKER
description:
At this school usual students study with vampires from wealthy families. She is a representative from disciplinary committee, he is a guy who breaks school rules. She is a hunter, he is a target. He is her stalker, she is his target.

(Source: Line Webtoon)

title: High School Boys Trapped in a Fantasy World
description:
School rivals, Charles and Kai, unexpectedly get transported to a fantasy world and discover details about themselves. 

- Webtoons

titles.title: High School Boys Trapped in a Fantasy World

title: Soulmate For Two
description: Linus the half-incubus has come to Halfling Institute to find his new life and a soulmate to call his own. But the institute's various residents don't make his stay nearly as safe and straightforward as he would have liked.

title: Room X Mate
description: Dongmi Lin—Nickname “Control Freak”, a college student who likes to control other people. One day he moves into a new dorm and meets an uncontrollable dorm mate, and f****d with him. His brain starts to uncontrollably generate fantasies...

title: Magic Soda Pop
description:
These sodas will give you more than just a sugar high -- they're full to the brim with magical powers! When Alaina discovers they can give her a boost in school, one sip is just too good to resist. But one drink leads to another, and soon she's on a slippery slope to unintended consequences. Can Alaina get herself dry, or will she lose everything to the fizzy feeling of magic soda pop?

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Dragon Claw
description:
As long as humanity can remember, they have been terrorized by gigantic creatures and terrifying monsters. On the brink of extinction, they have gathered on the last remaining continent still under their control and have managed to stabilize.

But what happens when that balance gets out of control?

A young member of the wind-clan gets caught up in this struggle for survival while trying to find her own place in this world. Will she be able to forge her own destiny?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Champ (H)
description:
A boy meets dog love story. *Silent comic* 

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Knight Of Chaos
description: A young boy named Fernando has an extremely difficult life, fighting day after day to maintain his studies so he can have a good profession and be able to help his family. After being set up by his college friends he loses everything he took so long to achieve, or at least Less is what he thought. He is given a great chance to change his destiny when he is introduced to a world completely unlike anything he has ever seen!

title: Ramia-Yana
description:
The fantasy epic of an unusual and mysterious hero called Ramia.

(Source: Pixiv)

title: Ethereal Madness
description: Pride was the most beautiful Succubi in the whole kingdom and he was engaged with Ardor, the crown prince. Before marrying Ardor and becoming the Succibi empress Pride was beheaded and killed by his fiancee in front of the whole kingdom after it was discovered that he was planning a rebellion against the royal family. After dying, Pride reincarnated as a human and read his own novel, discovering the tragic ending of all the characters. Would Pride ever have a second chance?

titles.title: Reincarnated as the Villain in a BL Novel

title: My Cat is a Wizard
description: Caitlyn is a struggling student in her final year of university. One day, her cat suddenly becomes human! She must now juggle her already difficult school and work life with more surprises that keep popping up...like her cat being a wizard.(Source: Webtoon)

title: The Violinist and the Nerd
description: This is the love story between a hikikomori videogame programmer and a violinist

title: Shoes for Cinderella
description: Love that starts from a shoe...

title: Atnomen
description:
Trapped in a betrothal to a cruel man and a religion that hates her kind, Lena goes searching for an angel...and finds salvation in the arms of a Monster...

(Source: Tapas)

title: I Am The Villain
description: A workaholic girl gets transported into the novel her best friend wrote and gets mistaken for the novel villainesse. why does she look exactly like her? why is she here? More importantly how is she going to avoid the drama and live a normal life?

title: Mr. Beta
description:
A beta writer find Muse inside his new alpha boss.. and write a novel modeled after him! What would he do when he got found out?

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Astray Goblin
description: Dago, at first, has zero interest in becoming a Crusader. But after a certain occurrence with him and his 'friends' and a reminder of said occurrence by a certain entity, he dedicates his future into becoming one. (Source: Webtoon)

title: Colossale
description:
Jade's social life is all mapped out: luxurious evenings, studies at a prestigious high school, a full notebook; all she has to do is find the ideal lover. But how can he succeed in falling into line when the only thing that obsesses him is doing bodybuilding all day long?

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Spellcross
description: When the threat of the Dungeons looms large in the land of Aria, adventurers rally to explore them in pursuit of fame and fortune. Young Caldwell is no different, but he faces one huge obstacle: where most everyone is able to cast spells in some form, his pitifully small essence pool means he can’t fight using magic like everyone else. He’ll need to turn the pacifistic powers of item creation and transmutation into battle techniques in order to survive, and pursue his dream of one day making a name for himself.

title: The Spectrum of Us
description:
In a world with different types of Kemonomimi (animal people), falling in love with other types is not socially accepted. But, when a cat and wolf find love, will they pull through their differences to reach their dreams, or will they be held back because of what they're "supposed" to be?

(Source: Webtoon)

title: HEART Anthology
description: Featuring stories from the 2020 Short Story Contest! From wholesome stories to tearjerkers, are you ready to catch these feelings?

title: Blades of Furry
description:
Emile is an up-and-coming skater in the beloved sport of Skate Battles, a high-stakes combo of figure skating and martial arts. Radu is a well-known senior skater and several time champ with the world at his feet. However, during an ill-fated match between the two, Emile discovers Radu's secret, which could threaten to destroy him. Will Emile keep his secret? Or could this rivalry turn into something more...?

(Source: Webtoons)

title: 1 Only Reason
description:
This is the story of Elishé, an asexual succubus who deals with depression once she's disinherited for deserting her own race. 

(Source: MangaDex, edited)

title: Murume PaVarume
description: 22 of the mightiest warriors in the world are gathered for a ceremony to determine the new Murume PaVarume, but before the ceremony even begins 20 of the warriors are kidnapped and thus our protagonist is given the title of Murume PaVarume along with the powers that come with it. Now he must go on a long quest to bring back the kidnapped warriors so the true Murume PaVarume can be chosen. (Source: Webtoon)

title: Ninecrow
description:
After Amanda's parents divorce, Amanda and her mom relocate to a new town. Amanda tries to be cooperative about the move, but her mom won't explain why they're there, or even how she heard of the strange place. As Amanda explores the town and begins to unravel the decades-old disappearances of girls around her age, she starts to fear she's in danger too. With her mom's behavior growing ever more detached and bizarre, will Amanda be able to save them both before it's too late?

Source - Webtoon

title: She weeps for the Devil
description:
A man comes to terms with the fact that some of his desires are evil. He will never be a hero. . . So who will show sympathy for him in his moments of doubt and pain?

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Sloppy First
description:
A Mess, But We Make It Right!

Psyche has fell in love with Olivia since elementary school, but he ends up having a relationship to Ezekiel who is Olivia's Crush!

title: Marvel Meow
description:
From Viz:  
Join Captain Marvel’s pet, Chewie, as she wreaks havoc in the lives of Marvel’s most popular characters! Gain a new perspective on beloved favorites such as Spider-Man and Iron Man, formidable villains including Thanos and Galactus, and antiheroes like Deadpool, as they all become the playthings of this capricious “cat” creature. Originally shared on Marvel’s official Instagram, these comic strips have been collected with all-new content into a gift book that will delight Marvel and cat enthusiasts alike!
